text.en:
That the provisions of Public Act Numbered Five hundred and twenty-one of the Seventy-fourth
Congress of the United States, approved on April sixteenth, nineteen hundred and thirty-six, be accepted, as it
is hereby accepted to be made applicable to all contracts for the carriage of goods by sea to and from
Philippine ports in foreign trade: Provided, That nothing in this Act shall be construed as repealing any
existing provision of the Code of Commerce which is now in force, or as limiting its application.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, October 22, 1936.
